top_recommendations.action: Formalise and publish a guest-facing sustainability programme leveraging existing EV charging and regional sourcing, and pursue a recognised green certification such as Green Key.
Partner with a local spa or therapist to introduce at least one bookable wellness experience that substantiates the 'kom helemaal tot rust' brand promise beyond the fitness room.
Create a dedicated accessibility page on the hotel website and brief front desk staff to proactively communicate room and facility adaptations to guests requiring them.
